brief:
The post that tagged the bot says:
We have the technology. We can build it

@buildthis.bisks.net Can you make a cookie-cutter style ragebait generator that assembles fake infuriating tweets (without getting racist or ___phobic) that hit trigger buttons in a maddening way? Use your superpowered theory of mind

What that post carries with it (this is what it's pointing at):
(attached to the post that tagged the bot)
  [quoting @eleanor.lockhart.contact: i wish that AI was better at theory of mind so I could ask it to show me a fake Bluesky with fake infuriating tweets that I can get fake mad at so I can get that mental stimulation without having to see real people who actually infuriate me]
note: fake infuriating posts from people who don't exist: pick triggers + a heat level, then 'make me mad'. petty annoyances only (dishwashers, airplane seats, the Oxford comma).
